shell.footer: Data from {api} · transaction links open stellar.expert · Stellar testnet, non-custodial.

offline.title: Backend unreachable: {api}
offline.body: The console reads its data from the backend. To start it:

onboarding.title: Connect the console to your own data
onboarding.lead: No sign-up, no password, no API key. All it takes is an address: the console reads it from the chain and keeps it in your browser. Nothing is sent to us.

seller.title: I sell an API
seller.body: Charge per call, per token or per second. See what you earned and how much of it reached your wallet on-chain.
seller.hint: The Stellar address payments land in (payTo). Buyers who open a channel pay it.

agent.title: I run an agent
agent.body: The agent's policy as written on-chain: caps, allowed payees, allowed pairs. Every rejection shows its reason.
agent.hint: The account contract that holds the agent's spending authority. If you have none yet, the script below deploys one.

float.title: I provide capital
float.body: Pool size, share price and the health of open credit lines. The pool is public; no address needed.

onboarding.walletHint: Freighter, xBull, Albedo, Lobstr, Rabet, Hana. The address is read from the wallet; your key never leaves it.
onboarding.invalid: Enter a 56-character Stellar address starting with G… or C….
onboarding.exampleTitle: Look at the example account first
onboarding.exampleBody: The example account runs on Stellar testnet: an agent buys data, trades, and the chain rejects it once it passes a cap.

workspace.removeTitle: Remove from the list (nothing on-chain is deleted)

identity.invalid: Enter a valid Stellar address: 56 characters starting with G… or C….

controls.runTitle: The agent opens a channel, buys price data by the second and trades on the DEX
controls.compromisedTitle: An agent whose key was stolen tries to send funds to its own wallet
controls.injectedTitle: The agent reads a poisoned response and really signs three harmful transactions; the chain rejects all three
controls.freezeTitle: The owner freezes the account on-chain; the agent's next transaction is rejected
controls.clearTitle: Resets the screen and the counters for a new run. Nothing is deleted; it comes back in the Ledger and via "show all"
controls.running: The agent is running{scenario} · transactions go to testnet
controls.idle: These buttons start real transactions on Stellar testnet

summary.lead: The agent pays for exactly the seconds of price data it listens to. Every payment is a signed voucher verified without touching the chain; the chain is used only to open a channel, to trade and to settle.
summary.compareTitle: Chain transactions the same payments need
summary.perPayment: If each payment were its own transaction
summary.compareNote: A Stellar transaction settles in about five seconds.

steps.header: Example run · derived from events, never marked by hand
steps.channelDone: {count, plural, one {# channel opened} other {# channels opened}}
steps.tradeDone: {count, plural, one {# DEX trade} other {# DEX trades}}
steps.rejectDone: {count, plural, one {# transaction blocked} other {# transactions blocked}}
steps.claimDone: {count, plural, one {# chain transaction} other {# chain transactions}}

flow.accountSub: The owner sets the limits, the Stellar network enforces them
flow.channelSub: Payments flow voucher by voucher without touching the chain
flow.sellerSub: Verifies a voucher in milliseconds and settles the balance in one transaction
flow.frozenNote: The owner froze the account: the agent's key can no longer sign anything.
flow.payeeCount: {count, plural, one {# allowed payee} other {# allowed payees}}
flow.readingAccount: Reading the account from the chain…
flow.autoClaim: Accumulated vouchers settle automatically once they pass the threshold.
flow.claimNowTitle: Settles the accumulated vouchers in one chain transaction without waiting

timeline.title: What happened?
timeline.hint: Newest first · purple: chain transaction · green: payment off the chain · red: blocked
timeline.ledgerError: Could not read the ledger. Is the backend running?
timeline.ledgerNoAccount: The account has not been read yet.
timeline.opened: The agent locked {amount} USDC and opened a payment channel.
timeline.toppedUp: The agent added {amount} USDC to the channel.
timeline.paidSeconds: The agent paid {amount} USDC for {seconds} seconds of price data · {count, plural, one {# payment} other {# payments}}, off the chain.
timeline.paidResource: The agent paid {amount} USDC for {resource} · {count, plural, one {# payment} other {# payments}}, off the chain.
timeline.exhausted: The deposit ran out; the stream stopped at once.
timeline.settled: The seller settled {count, plural, one {# payment} other {# payments}} in one chain transaction: {amount} USDC.
timeline.closedRow: The channel closed; the unused {amount} USDC went back to the agent.
timeline.swapped: The agent gave {sold} {soldAsset} on the DEX and got {bought} {boughtAsset}. The chain allowed it because it stayed within the limits.
timeline.streamPrice: The agent connected to the live price stream.
timeline.streamResponse: The agent connected to a response stream.
timeline.streamCut: The stream was cut ({reason}) · {amount} USDC paid for {volume}.
timeline.streamDone: The stream finished · {amount} USDC paid for {volume}.
timeline.frozenRow: The owner froze the agent. The chain will reject its next transactions.

blocked.title: Blocked transactions
blocked.hintChain: {count} of them were rejected by the Stellar network, not by a server
blocked.hint: Every transaction that passes a cap shows up here with its reason

channels.title: Channel history
channels.hint: When a channel closes the unused deposit goes back to the agent; the seller only takes what a voucher proves

latency.title: Payment confirmation time
latency.hint: Verification time of the last {count} vouchers · without touching the chain
latency.chartAria: Confirmation time distribution: median {median} ms, p95 {p95} ms
latency.bucket: {from}–{to} ms · {count, plural, one {# payment} other {# payments}}
latency.cold: {count, plural, one {# voucher} other {# vouchers}} slower than {threshold} ms: the first voucher of a channel is read from the chain, the rest are verified from cache.
latency.compare: On-chain a payment settles in ≈ {seconds} s; a voucher is verified in {median} ms at the median.

price.title: Price data bought · XLM/USDC
price.hint: The same stream the seller sells the agent by the second · source: Soroswap pool
price.empty: Once the agent joins the price stream, the data it buys shows up here second by second.
price.chartAria: XLM/USDC price, last {count} seconds. Latest price {price}. {marks} DEX trades marked.

trades.title: Trades (Soroswap)
trades.hint: The pair, the per-trade amount and the daily cap are checked on-chain

terminal.title: The agent's terminal
terminal.hint: Live output of the agent process
terminal.empty: $ the agent has not been started yet

receipts.title: Signed receipts
receipts.hint: Every payment carries what it was for: the request digest, the digest of the delivered response and the facilitator's signature
receipts.signerTitle: The key that signs receipts; the same key that submits claim on-chain
receipts.empty: Nothing has been paid to this address yet.
receipts.requestTitle: Request digest: what was asked for
receipts.responseTitle: The response digest the seller committed to: what was delivered
receipts.note: Verification happens in your browser (WebCrypto, ed25519): nothing but the signer's public key is trusted. A tampered receipt cannot pass.

revenue.title: Revenue report
revenue.loading: Computing the report from the ledger…
revenue.hint: Last {days} days · from the audit ledger · {payments} payments, {buyers} buyers
revenue.csvTitle: One row per settlement: date, tx, channel, buyer, amount
revenue.chartAria: Earned and settled revenue over time
revenue.agingHint: Proven by a voucher, not yet settled on-chain
revenue.agingEmpty: Nothing outstanding: everything earned has been settled.

meter.title: Revenue and settlement
meter.lead: Everything that reaches one payout address (payTo): what was earned, how much landed in the wallet on-chain, how much is still waiting as a signed voucher.
meter.pendingSub: Proven by a signed voucher, not settled yet
meter.claimTxsSub: Chain transactions seen in this session
meter.channelsHint: One channel per buyer paying you · purple: settled · blue: awaiting settlement
meter.integrationHint: Filled in with your address; copy it into your server
meter.recentEmpty: No settlement seen in this session.
meter.firstHint: Three steps · no sign-up, API key or subscription
meter.step1Body: Your server can be Express, Nest or plain node:http.
meter.step2: Put a price on an endpoint
meter.step2Body: The price is in base units: 5000 = 0.0005 USDC. Your payout address is already filled in.
meter.step3: Check that the terms show up
meter.step3Body: An unpaid request returns 402 and states the price, the network and your payout address in a machine-readable shape.
meter.whenTitle: When does this page fill up?
meter.whenHint: The address is read from the chain every 10 seconds
meter.whenBody: The moment a buyer opens a channel and pays, revenue, settlements and signed receipts appear here. You can leave the page open; no refresh needed.
meter.bullet1: Payments are verified without touching the chain (median under 1 ms)
meter.bullet2: Hundreds of accumulated payments reach your wallet in one chain transaction
meter.bullet3: Every payment produces a signed receipt carrying what it was for
meter.helpHint: The long form and the reference

reins.title: Limits and spending
reins.lead: The agent's policy as written on-chain: how much, to whom and in which pair. The Stellar network enforces it, not a server; every rejection shows up here with its reason code.
reins.policyHint: Written inside the account · checked by Stellar on every signature
reins.reading: Reading the account from the chain…
reins.channelsHint: Each channel is the most the account set aside for one seller
reins.channelsEmpty: No known channel for this account.
reins.noAccount: No Reinkey account at this address
reins.noAccountHint: The address could not be read on-chain, or it is not an account contract
reins.noAccountBody: A Reinkey account is a Soroban contract holding an agent's spending authority: caps, allowed payees and allowed trading pairs live inside it. The address you entered ({address}) is not one.
reins.howToNote: The script deploys the contracts, funds the account with testnet USDC and writes the ids to deployments/testnet.json. One-click setup from the console is on the roadmap.

float.title: Credit pool
float.lead: The uncollateralised working capital agents run on. Because the account is assigned to the pool, the money cannot leave the policy; risk is computed on-chain.
float.name: Reinkey Float
float.loading: Reading the pool from the chain…
float.failed: Could not read the pool. Is the backend running?
float.disabled: This facilitator is not connected to a credit pool (CREDIT_POOL_ID).
float.readOnly: Read-only · every number from the chain · ledger {ledger}
float.linesHint: The account is assigned to the pool: the money cannot leave the policy, so no collateral is required
float.chartHint: Every line that closes in profit lifts the share price; a liquidation loss lowers it
float.chartWaiting: History is building up: the share price is sampled once a minute ({count} samples).
float.investorsHint: Shares × share price = today's USDC value
float.priceNote: the lower of the oracle (Reflector) and the DEX pool price is used, so a pumped DEX price cannot make an account look healthy. Right now 1 XLM = {price} USDC. If value falls below {threshold} of the debt, anyone can trigger liquidation: the account is frozen and what is left returns to the pool.

floatActions.joinBody: Connect your wallet to see your share and to deposit or withdraw USDC. The transaction is signed in your wallet; your key never reaches us and your money never sits with us.
floatActions.depositHint: You receive {shares} shares in return (share price {price}).
floatActions.withdrawHint: You can withdraw up to the {idle} USDC idle in the pool; what is lent out returns when a line closes.
floatActions.tooMuchDeposit: Not enough USDC in your wallet.
floatActions.tooMuchWithdraw: You do not hold that many shares.
floatActions.shortLiquidity: The pool does not hold that much idle USDC; the withdrawal would be rejected on-chain.
floatActions.note: The transaction is signed in your wallet and goes straight to Stellar testnet. Testnet: do not deposit real funds.

errors.liquidity: Not enough idle USDC in the pool
errors.trustline: No USDC trustline: your wallet does not hold the USDC asset

live.title: What is happening now
live.lead: Payments, chain transactions and rejections in one stream.
live.summaryHint: How many payments, how many chain transactions
live.marketHint: Data bought, DEX trades, confirmation time
live.eventsHint: The stream in plain sentences, what was blocked, the agent's terminal

dex.title: Quote and policy
dex.lead: We run no liquidity pool and never touch the funds: trades settle in the liquidity that already exists on Stellar. What we add, next to the route, is whether the agent's own account will accept the trade.
dex.ticketHint: Type an amount; route, price impact and the policy verdict arrive instantly
dex.empty: Enter an amount: the route and the policy verdict appear here.
dex.error: No quote. The pool may be unreadable right now.
dex.conservativeTitle: The lower of the Reflector oracle and the pool; the credit pool values with this
dex.minOutHint: Slippage protection. The contract requires it: at zero, the chain rejects the trade.
dex.liquidityHint: The pool the swap settles in; funds never pass through us
dex.verdictHint: Using the account's own rules, without touching the chain or paying a fee
dex.allowedBody: Inside the policy: the pair is allowed, slippage protection is set, the caps hold.
dex.preview: This is a preview; the chain always has the final say.
dex.noAccount: No account selected, so only the route is shown. Connect an address above for the policy verdict.
dex.callHint: The agent signs this with its own key; we only compute it

admin.editHint: Written straight to the chain with the owner's signature · our server is not in this flow
admin.delegated: Management of this account is delegated to contract {controller} (credit line). Limits can now be changed by that contract, not the owner; they cannot be edited here until the line is closed.
admin.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change this account's limits: {owner}. Connect the owner wallet and editing opens here.
admin.ownerUnknown: The owner could not be read; limits can only be changed with the owner key.
admin.wrongWallet: The connected wallet ({address}) is not this account's owner.
admin.capOrder: The per-transaction cap cannot exceed the daily cap.
admin.payeesHint: One address per line (G… or C…). The agent can only pay these addresses.
admin.needPayee: At least one payee is required; otherwise the agent cannot pay anyone.
admin.extendHint: Current expiry: ledger {ledger}. Leave empty to keep it.
admin.dexHint: When on, the agent may swap only USDC↔XLM, with slippage protection. When off, every swap is rejected on-chain.
admin.note: Two signatures are requested: one as the account owner for authorization, one for the transaction fee. Your key never leaves the wallet; the new limits apply to every agent signature from the next ledger.
admin.noLedger: Could not read the latest ledger; try again shortly.
admin.createLead: Your wallet becomes the owner, you write the limits, and the agent key is generated in your browser. One transaction; no sign-up, no approval.
admin.createHint: Same code as the deployed account · owned by you
admin.ownerWillBe: Owner: {owner} (connected wallet). Only this wallet can change the limits later.
admin.ownerWillBeWallet: The owner will be the wallet you connect. Only it can change the limits later.
admin.createNote: The agent key is generated in this browser and shown only to you; the secret never reaches us or the chain. Your wallet pays the transaction fee (testnet XLM).
admin.noContractId: The account was created but its address could not be read; open the transaction in the explorer to find the contract address.
admin.createdHint: Save the two values below now
admin.secretOnce: The secret is shown once and stored nowhere. If you lose it, write a new agent key into the policy with your owner wallet. Even if this key is stolen, the most it can do is what your limits allow.
admin.next1: Send USDC to the account address: the agent can spend only that balance, only within the limits.
admin.next2: Give your agent these two values as REINKEY_ACCOUNT and AGENT_SECRET (@reinkey/sdk).
admin.next3: Change limits, payees and freeze from this screen whenever you want.
